title: SAF Recaptures Magaja and Sarkam, Blue Nile State
detail: SAF's 4th Infantry Division announced from Ed Damazin the recapture of Magaja and Sarkam on June 29, 2026, after direct engagement with the combined RSF-SPLM-N alliance, which retreated. Sarkam lies northeast of Kurmuk near Sali and Dandro, and was described by SAF as key to securing Ed Damazin, Blue Nile's regional capital, ahead of a planned push to retake Kurmuk itself.

title: Sudan's Health Ministry Formally Declares Cholera Outbreak in West Kordofan
detail: Sudan's Health Ministry formally declared a cholera outbreak in West Kordofan State on June 29, 2026, citing 838 suspected cases, 7 confirmed infections, and 117 deaths as of June 20. The declaration triggered an expanded WHO/UN response, though access constraints from ongoing fighting in North and South Kordofan hampered delivery of treatment supplies and oral cholera vaccines in the following weeks.
